entities.name: Anke Kühn
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Anke Kühne is a field hockey player from Germany, who played for the German national team and won the gold medal at the 2004 Summer Olympics in Athens, Greece. She is married to German sculler Tobias Kühne. She has represented Germany in 181 matches.
